hypothesis: The zero-margin softplus supplies the correct gradient direction, but its force decays once a pair is merely ordered and does not require useful separation. Replacing it with the same smooth loss at a fixed one-logit positive margin should directly enlarge SELECTED-minus-PLAUSIBLE margins while preserving the V2 gradient direction and all absolute-label supervision.

protocolVerification.requiredOnlyMaterialChange: ranking loss formula gains fixed positive margin 1.0

exactChangeFromV2: ranking term only: softplus(z_plausible - z_selected) -> softplus(1.0 + z_plausible - z_selected)
finalPolicy: No Final Test file reads, inference, error inspection, tuning, or model-selection use.

training.checkpointRule: save and evaluate the final one-epoch checkpoint only

loss.bceReduction: mean over unmasked Product-18 cells within each row
loss.ranking: mean softplus(1.0 + z_plausible - z_selected) over the within-row Cartesian product
loss.rowReduction: L_bce + lambdaRank * L_rank, then unweighted batch mean

stoppingAndSelectionRule: one epoch; final checkpoint only; KEEP_CANDIDATE only on all nine unchanged Dev gates, otherwise REJECT_CANDIDATE; no restart or rescue run

expectedMeasurableEffect.primary: Dev P0 raw-ranking Macro and selected-above-plausible rate exceed V2, with bad-to-good P0 flips exceeding good-to-bad flips
expectedMeasurableEffect.margin: mean and median Dev P0 SELECTED-minus-PLAUSIBLE margin exceed V2
expectedMeasurableEffect.secondary: P0 directional Macro exceeds V2 without violating the unchanged FP guard
expectedMeasurableEffect.failureCondition: relational ordering remains flat or worsens even if scalar losses or Macro-F1 improve
